name: cortex-sidekick
description: Lets the Claude Code desktop app work beside you in VS Code: live edit highlights with one-click revert, Problems panel and terminal output for Claude, and a visible terminal it can run commands in. Local MCP server, loopback only.

commands.title: Cortex Sidekick: Accept all Claude edits
Cortex Sidekick: Copy Claude Code setup command

cortexSidekick.port.description: Loopback port for the MCP server. Must match the URL registered with `claude mcp add`.

enumDescriptions: Show edits Claude reports through the Cortex hook (precise; recommended).
Also show ANY change made to workspace files outside VS Code (formatters and build tools included).
Never open or highlight files automatically.

cortexSidekick.highlightSeconds.description: How long changed lines stay highlighted. 0 = until you accept or revert.

cortexSidekick.terminalName.description: Name of the terminal Claude runs commands in.
